title: Permissive-Operator Surcharge Is Not Refundable
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), a permissive-operator surcharge is never refunded. It is taken off the deductible a refund is figured on:
- **Collision.** When the operator recorded on the claim report is a permissive user who does not live in the household and the cause is a collision, the permissive-collision surcharge of 500 USD is taken off.
- **Comprehensive.** When that operator is such a permissive user and the cause is comprehensive, the permissive-comprehensive surcharge of 250 USD is taken off.
- **Any other operator.** Nothing is taken off.

| Operator on the claim report | Collision cause | Comprehensive cause |
|---|---|---|
| Permissive user not living in the household | 500 USD taken off | 250 USD taken off |
| Rated driver, named excluded driver, unlisted household resident, or no driver | Nothing taken off | Nothing taken off |

### Hypothetical cases

- A visiting friend was driving in a single-vehicle collision, and 1,500.00 USD of deductible was withheld. The refund is figured on 1,000.00 USD.
- The same friend was driving when the car was vandalised, and 750.00 USD was withheld. The refund is figured on 500.00 USD.
